In article <8plpii$vr2$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,
francoi...@my-deja.com wrote:

> I don't know if you have already answered to this,

> but how does that (Protected Resources) card exactly work?

The first thing to do is always to check the official card text here:
http://www.white-wolf.com/VTES/

Which gives us this:

"Protected Resources (V:TES)
2 pool -- Master
Master. If this card is in play, <you do not burn more than two pool
when a minion bleeds you, regardless of the amount of the bleed>. Burn
this card if you successfully bleed another Methuselah."

> Does it limit the bleed to 2 per minion
> or to 2 per Methuselah's minions?

As you can see, from the official text (corrected / interpreted /
explained text), it limits the amount of pool you lose for a bleed to
be no more than two. Each of your predators minions may bleed you for
4, but you will only lose two pool each time.

And yes, LSJ has answered this before.
